description: This file defines the 'Node' class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node in the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) used during template compilation. It includes methods for managing child nodes, attributes, source context, and deprecated features.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in Twig's AST, supporting child nodes, attributes, iteration, and deprecation handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Node instance with child nodes, attributes, line number, and optional tag.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including its attributes and children for debugging.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Encodes the node into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number in the source template where this node was defined.

methods.name: getNodeTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this node, if any.

methods.name: setNodeTag
methods.description: Sets the tag name for this node; can only be set once.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks whether a specific attribute exists.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute, with optional deprecation handling.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Assigns a value to an attribute, with optional deprecation warnings.

methods.name: deprecateAttribute
methods.description: Marks an attribute as deprecated with a specific deprecation policy.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the node.

methods.name: hasNode
methods.description: Checks whether a child node exists by name.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by name, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets a child node by name, with deprecation warnings.

methods.name: removeNode
methods.description: Removes a child node by name.

methods.name: deprecateNode
methods.description: Marks a child node as deprecated.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over child nodes.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template source, if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the source context for the node and propagates it to children.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context object.
